subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: After the duplicate parser surface is removed, should OpenClaw adopt RFC 0016’s grouped one-Claw/one-agent schema and read-only add-plan contracts as an experimental core CLI foundation?
rationale: This PR creates a new core packaging and lifecycle contract consumed by a large dependent stack; correctness review cannot decide whether that product and ownership boundary should become OpenClaw policy.

options.title: Approve a minimal gated foundation
options.body: Land the canonical read-only schema and planner only after parser cleanup, rebase, and exact-head review.

options.title: Revise the contract first
options.body: Keep the PR open while schema, CLI names, portability rules, or owner boundaries are narrowed in the RFC.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Do not merge this foundation if maintainers do not accept the RFC as a core capability.

recommendation.title: Approve a minimal gated foundation
recommendation.body: Land the canonical read-only schema and planner only after parser cleanup, rebase, and exact-head review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review evidence makes this the strongest cross-surface product-decision route for the agent, CLI, cron, and configuration boundaries.
